verdict.rationale: Adyen clearly supports in-person card acceptance. It offers PCI PTS 6 certified terminals driven by the Terminal API and a standalone terminal option. Contactless acceptance is explicitly documented, including Tap to Pay on iPhone and on compatible smartphones, and the docs say terminals accept global and local payment methods. However, chip (EMV) insertion and Apple Pay / Google Pay wallets are never named; they are only implied by the generic terminal, CVM and payment-method claims. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of chip/EMV acceptance, explicit Apple Pay/Google Pay mobile-wallet support at the terminal, independent or hands-on corroboration.
